value.rationale: An exact known-body, two-observation inverse direction problem is a natural geometrical tomography question. Unlike marginals/covariance, the theorem exactly determines two-valued inverse fibers, their spherical probability for all triaxial boxes, its full sharp range (0,1), and the full joint density. The sharp spherical-hexagon calculation provides structural information about when two observables do not uniquely reconstruct direction.
